name: stale-data-notice
title: Stale Data Notice
description: Banner that appears when a tab comes back after a while (default 5 min away) or the data passes its max age (default 10 min), says how old it is and why that matters, and offers a one-tap refresh.

meta.summary: Tells people when the numbers on screen may be out of date, after time away or past a max age, with a one-tap refresh.
catches: Returning to the tab after being away longer than awayAfter
limits: Age comes from the updatedAt you pass
Does not refresh by itself; onRefresh does
a11y: Notice is role=status; errors use role=alert
Refresh button disables while refreshing; dismiss has an aria-label
